title: coap: No 5.03 backoff handling
close_reason: Fixed: Rust CoAP client now implements 5.03 Service Unavailable backoff per spec 07 section 10.2.3. Added Response::is_service_unavailable(), max_age parsing, ServiceUnavailableError type, CoapClient struct with peer backoff tracking (HashMap<SocketAddr, Instant>), and request blocking during backoff. Default 60s backoff when no Max-Age, capped at 3600s for security.
